eyebrow.en: Compare two Claude Code transcripts and locate the first difference in their tool inputs.

sub.zh: 对照两次 Claude Code 会话，定位工具输入首次出现差异的位置。
sub.en: Compare two Claude Code transcripts and locate the first difference in their tool inputs.

caption.zh: 会话对照 · 工具输入

body.zh: Edit、Write 与 MultiEdit 的指纹包含内容信息。
body.en: Edit, Write and MultiEdit fingerprints include content information.

body.zh: cwd、分支与 prompt 不同会被提示。
body.en: Differences in cwd, branch or prompt are surfaced.

body.zh: 终端、JSON 与本地并排 UI 使用同一比较结果。
body.en: Terminal, JSON and local UI share the same comparison result.

title.zh: 把长会话缩到一个可检查的差异
title.en: Turn a long transcript into a focused comparison

body.zh: 同一个修复任务，两次 Agent 会话可能选择相同工具，却写入不同内容。BisectRun 读取已经保存的会话，先比较任务签名，再按时间顺序对齐工具输入，让你从第一个不匹配处开始调查。
body.en: Two runs of a repair task may choose the same tools but write different content. BisectRun reads saved transcripts, checks their task signatures, and compares tool inputs in chronological order so you can start reviewing at the first mismatch.

body.zh: 演示使用仓库自带的合成会话：第一个 Bash 输入相同，第二个 Edit 输入不同。没有启动 Agent，也没有证明该差异就是故障原因。
body.en: The demo uses the shipped synthetic transcripts: the first Bash input matches and the second Edit input differs. No agent is started, and the mismatch is not proof of the failure cause.

alt.zh: 演示使用仓库自带的合成会话：第一个 Bash 输入相同，第二个 Edit 输入不同。没有启动 Agent，也没有证明该差异就是故障原因。
alt.en: The demo uses the shipped synthetic transcripts: the first Bash input matches and the second Edit input differs. No agent is started, and the mismatch is not proof of the failure cause.

body.zh: parse-jsonl.ts 将 tool_use 与 tool_result 关联并建立 Span 树；align.ts 将其展平后逐项比较按工具定义的指纹。cli.ts 输出文字或 JSON，server.ts 提供本地并排视图。这个过程读取历史记录，不重新执行工具调用。
body.en: parse-jsonl.ts pairs tool_use and tool_result records into Span trees. align.ts flattens the trees and compares tool-specific fingerprints in order. cli.ts emits text or JSON; server.ts supplies the local side-by-side view. The process reads history without executing the recorded calls.

alt.zh: parse-jsonl.ts 将 tool_use 与 tool_result 关联并建立 Span 树；align.ts 将其展平后逐项比较按工具定义的指纹。cli.ts 输出文字或 JSON，server.ts 提供本地并排视图。这个过程读取历史记录，不重新执行工具调用。
alt.en: parse-jsonl.ts pairs tool_use and tool_result records into Span trees. align.ts flattens the trees and compares tool-specific fingerprints in order. cli.ts emits text or JSON; server.ts supplies the local side-by-side view. The process reads history without executing the recorded calls.

body.zh: 输入是会话 JSONL，输出可用于人工检查或脚本消费；JSON 与 UI 共享紧凑结果字段，不重复输出整个 commonPrefix 树。
body.en: Inputs are transcript JSONL files; outputs support human review or scripts. JSON and UI use the compact result fields without repeating the full commonPrefix tree.

alt.zh: 输入是会话 JSONL，输出可用于人工检查或脚本消费；JSON 与 UI 共享紧凑结果字段，不重复输出整个 commonPrefix 树。
alt.en: Inputs are transcript JSONL files; outputs support human review or scripts. JSON and UI use the compact result fields without repeating the full commonPrefix tree.

body.zh: 0 为找到差异，2 为完全对齐，1 为错误；不要将 2 当作解析失败。
body.en: 0 means a divergence, 2 means complete alignment, and 1 means an error; do not treat 2 as a parse failure.

note.zh: 演示使用仓库自带的合成会话：第一个 Bash 输入相同，第二个 Edit 输入不同。没有启动 Agent，也没有证明该差异就是故障原因。
note.en: The demo uses the shipped synthetic transcripts: the first Bash input matches and the second Edit input differs. No agent is started, and the mismatch is not proof of the failure cause.

body.zh: 匹配深度为 1，差异位于 Edit。
body.en: The matched depth is one; the divergence is an Edit.

body.zh: JSON 保留双方签名和两个差异 Span。
body.en: JSON retains both signatures and divergent spans.

body.zh: 需要 Node.js 20+；依赖安装需要网络，下面的显式双文件示例完全离线。
body.en: Requires Node.js 20+. Dependency installation needs network access; the explicit two-file example below runs offline.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/bisectrun.git
cd bisectrun
npm ci
npm run build

node dist/cli.js test/fixtures/failed-session.jsonl test/fixtures/good-session.jsonl --no-color
node dist/cli.js test/fixtures/failed-session.jsonl test/fixtures/good-session.jsonl --json

limitations.zh: 指纹使用工具字段的有限前缀，不是完整语义等价或因果归因。
limitations.en: Fingerprints use bounded tool-field prefixes, not full semantic equivalence or causal attribution.

limitations.zh: 主要对齐依据是工具输入；结果内容不同不一定触发差异。
limitations.en: Alignment primarily compares tool inputs; different result content need not trigger divergence.

limitations.zh: 自动参考选择中的成功是启发式判断，不代替测试结果。
limitations.en: Success in automatic reference selection is a heuristic, not a substitute for tests.

changelog.note: fix: span fingerprints now discriminate full content (a divergence past the first line/60 chars of an Edit, Write, MultiEdit, Bash or TodoWrite input is no longer silently missed), non-transcript JSONL inputs fail loudly, the documented session-id argument form works, and the --ui #result payload round-trips markup exactly.

fix: version-drift lockstep — every version-reporting surface (package.json, CLI --version, UI footer, VERSION, CHANGELOG) now advances in lockstep with the release tag, with a regression test guarding against future drift.
refresh: content re-verified for v0.7.0 (fix-write-multiedit-fingerprint-ignores-content — Write/MultiEdit spans now fingerprint content like Edit, so divergences between runs are no longer missed).
